 WWE HOFer Flattered By Chelsea Green's Halloween Costume
 By   Daisy Ruth 
 Nov. 7, 2026 12:00 pm EST 
 WWE 
 Add Wrestling Inc. on Google: 
 Preferred Source 
 Google Discover 
 WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green successfully defended her gold against a heel Nikki Bella on the October 30 edition of "WWE SmackDown." Despite the loss, and out of storyline, the WWE Hall of Famer showed love to the champion for her Halloween costume.
 Green, a vocal fan of E! Network reality series "Total Divas," and the Divas era of WWE as a whole, dressed up as Bella's "Fearless Nikki" persona. Bella told Justin Dorazio of SportsRadio 94WIP that seeing Green, and others, dress up as her, makes her feel "so iconic."
 "Especially when I'm seeing everyone hit the booty shake, and it's like, you get super flattered," Bella said. "It honestly made me smile. I didn't even know, I was on my way to the airport... My mom called me on the way to the airport and she's like, 'Oh my gosh, did you see Chelsea Green's live?' I'm like, 'No.' So, when I got to the airport I saw it and honestly, I always get so flattered. I don't even know how to put it into words, but it makes me feel very, very good. Like, super awesome and just totally iconic."
 The champion will go on to fight for the Crown Jewel Championship in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia against Women's World Champion Liv Morgan. As for Bella, her next storyline remains unknown to fans, especially after her twin sister Brie's injury at SummerSlam . Bella has reportedly drawn praise in WWE for her social media clip numbers , as well as her merchandise sales.
